beats.text: Everything stops. The dust hangs in the air. The air itself has stopped moving; somewhere under you the planet has stopped turning. You can still move, but not here. Not in your body. The thing you were fighting is stopped mid-motion, close enough to touch.
Then the lights go out. Lights that weren't even there. The sun goes out. Everything is black but the faintest glow of the room you're in.
The noise. You went outside to see what the noise was. In this world. I laughed out loud.
Yeah, this is going to be neat. Hold still. Well, you can't not, can you—
Something huge and jointed takes him out of the dark. A quarter of a second, if that: something like a mantis. A crack, like a shell giving way.
Then nothing. There is nothing. It is just you.

You want to know why. Everyone does. I have built this place every way it can be built, every stone of it, since before the atoms had names, and I got sick of watching it stand. So now I push. Once, at the right place, and I watch it go. The most fun game of dominoes there ever was.

Day 211, 21:40: you chose to leave the stockroom, thinking "I'll be quick." Day 212, 03:12: something scraped behind the dumpster. You noticed it. You did nothing. Do you know how much effort it takes to keep a runner in one alley for two days? Mara knows. She was the bait. I didn't have to touch you once. I gave you a revolver and Mara. And still.

Did you know something has been in that alley with you? For six hours. You never noticed. In about 30 seconds you are going to die. I won't tell you how. You should have paid more attention. Like I did.
Then the dust moves again. You are screaming.
